Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Open to AI engineering and full-stack platform leadership roles. Also offers 1:1 AI advisory for professionals (in Spanish).

## Selected work
- MotherDuck: AI video pipeline (YouTube → Whisper → translation → Strapi, Python); dependency security campaign (critical/high vulns to zero); Strapi link checker (264 broken links, 4 min → 33 s).
- Ampersand: ampersand.ai relaunch on Astro as lead engineer (PostHog/GTM, 71% legacy URLs redirected 1:1).
- CodSpeed: homepage v2 on Next.js App Router, SEO/GEO/AEO (dynamic OG, sitemap, structured data).
- LiteDesigner: internal MCP server for design references (Next.js, Neon/Drizzle, Better Auth, AWS worker).
- imetriq: ad metrics platform (Next.js + NestJS, BigQuery, MongoDB, Docker on AWS).
- DrLullaby: full-stack + DevOps across Vue 2, NestJS and Spring Boot.
